title: How to organize the dresser drawers | Kids Bedroom
description:
Folded everyday clothes a child can get themselves dressed from without asking.

This is the Dresser Drawers in the Kids Bedroom. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Five drawers, one category each, each with a picture label on the drawer front. Socks and underwear standing upright in rows so every pair is visible from above. Every drawer closes with one push, no pressing down. Dresser strapped to the wall, nothing on top of it worth climbing for.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: One drawer at a time, tipped out onto the bed.
Straighten: File fold upright so the drawer reads like a card index and the child sees every shirt without excavating.
Shine: Pull the drawers right out of the carcass, vacuum the inside of the frame, and wipe the runners.
Safety: A chest of drawers with two drawers open is a climbing frame, and it tips forward onto the child climbing it.
Standardize: A picture label on each drawer front showing what is inside, socks on the socks drawer, so the child both find
Sustain: Refolding happens straight out of the laundry basket and into the drawer standing up, never stacked flat on th

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
One category per drawer, file folded upright, quantities set by the wash rhythm, and every drawer closes with a single push.
